```plato

// A 3D curve with a defined first derivative. TangentAt is the velocity,
// CurvatureAt is the unsigned space curvature, and TorsionAt measures how
// sharply the curve leaves its osculating plane
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torsion_of_a_curve).
interface IDifferentiableCurve3D
    inherits ICurve3D
{
    TangentAt(x: Self, t: Number): Vector3D;
    CurvatureAt(x: Self, t: Number): Number;
    TorsionAt(x: Self, t: Number): Number;
}
```
